# Fortune Jobs AI

> Free U.S. job search for college students, new graduates and job seekers: 16,000+ open jobs refreshed daily, AI résumé matching, a free ATS résumé score, a work-authorization filter, and an application tracker.

Fortune Jobs AI lists open U.S. jobs gathered from employer career boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Breezy), USAJOBS and job-search partners (Adzuna, Jooble, WhatJobs). Each listing links to the original posting. Creating an account and the core tools are free; Fortune Jobs AI Pro is $9.99/month for more results per search and extra AI features.

## Main pages
- [Home and job search](https://fortunejobsai.com/): search by role, city or state, or describe the job in plain English
- [Find jobs](https://fortunejobsai.com/find-jobs.html): search U.S. jobs by title and location
- [Jobs by state and city](https://fortunejobsai.com/jobs/): live job counts for each role, state and major city
- [Résumé match](https://fortunejobsai.com/resume-search.html): upload a résumé for a free ATS score and matching jobs
- [Résumé builder](https://fortunejobsai.com/resume-builder.html): build an ATS-friendly résumé and download a PDF
- [About](https://fortunejobsai.com/about.html)
- [Contact](https://fortunejobsai.com/contact.html): info@fortunejobsai.com
